title: E7 WRR-floor test is vacuous: weights {100,1,1} exceed MAX_WEIGHT=64, are silently rejected, and the zero-share premise never holds
detail: submit_c swallows the Invalid_Weights rejection, so the pipe keeps default weights {1,4,1}: narrow capacity 5 allocates Standard 3 units, not 0. The assertion passes with the E7 floor code deleted — the floor is effectively untested.
recommended_fix: Use valid floor-triggering weights (e.g. {64,1,1} on narrow) and make submit_c tfail on validation error.

title: Queue-overflow shed (queue_drop_depth, newest-first) and the E9 drop-ladder emptiness combos have no test
evidence:
+				if idx_in_lane > int(bal.queue_drop_depth) {
+					// per-lane queue bound: beyond the depth, packets shed
+					// newest-first (the Godot prototype's actual behavior —
+					// its comment claimed oldest-first; the comment lied)
+					drop_packet(f, idx, .Queue_Overflow, &arrived)
detail: No test file references Queue_Overflow or queue_drop_depth (grep: 0 hits). §11.7 E9 wants the full ladder across emptiness combos; only the promote/demote flow test touches contention indirectly. Shed order and depth boundary are unverified.
recommended_fix: Add a flow test that overfills one lane's queue and asserts newest-first Queue_Overflow drops at the catalog depth.

title: Node-health warning surface (Strained/Critical, Warning_Raised/Cleared) has zero coverage
detail: No test touches crisis_evaluate or Ev_Warning_* (grep core/*_test.odin: 0 hits). The prior round's lesson was zero NetworkHealth coverage; health is now tested, but the 🟡/🔴 threshold transitions, tombstone reset, and cleared-on-healthy are not.
recommended_fix: Unit-test crisis_evaluate with synthetic node_load against the catalog strain/critical thresholds.

title: Catalog fail-fast validation (ODN-5) has no failure-path test
detail: Tests only exercise success-path loads (must_catalogs; the patched-pool-cap fixture). None of the named rejections — bad logic_hz, unknown class refs, empty ids, breach_exit < win, rolling_window bounds — is asserted. The loader is the ODN-5 gate.
recommended_fix: Table-drive one test per loader rejection rule.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: replay byte-identity on a guarded packet-rich command-built topology, seed reproduce/diverge, log round-trip + corrupt rejection, health win/lose/drain/grace/hysteresis/flap, surge-win and idle-404 full runs — all green (40 core + 5 app tests run). P1 ~85%: E7 floor test vacuous, E9 ladder/overflow shed and the warning surface untested; E26, ports, upgrade delta/span, batch E23, E22, E28, E1, E31 covered. Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Fix the E7 test premise and add E9/warning-surface coverage to reach PASS.
